headline: Fronts Stir as Drowned Vale Leads Base Fighting
war_summary: The latest ledger shows Drowned Vale has become the most immediate base-fighting theatre, posting seven strategic-base events in two hours and 29 across the day; its 12 bases remain divided, 11 Colonial to one Warden. Stema Landing has also erupted, with five events in the latest two hours and seven in 24 hours, leaving eight Colonial and one Warden base. Deadlands reports two fresh events, 14 for the day, and continues to carry the heaviest casualty load, with six Warden and five Colonial bases held. The great struggle at Endless Shore is quiet in the latest two-hour window but remains the day’s busiest recorded front, with 42 events and sharply accelerating casualty and enlistment rates. Farranac Coast has 18 daily events and rising one-hour casualty rates, though no recent two-hour base movement is logged. Loch Mor records no fresh two-hour event, yet its casualty rates are accelerating and 11 daily events mark it as a live watch. Other regions show little or no recorded base movement.
